_comment: The one rule for 'is this usable as a login / [users].admins entry?'. Read by BOTH src/company/manifest.rs's validator (via its test) and frontend/src/lib/company-setup.ts (adminEmailProblem). The host rule is deliberately LOOSE — normalize_email is trim+lowercase, and the only structural demands are 'not empty', 'no whitespace inside' and 'LoginIdentity::parse reads it as an email, not as the wallet: or local: scheme'. It does NOT demand an '@': a login on a host with no mail transport is a username, not a mailbox, and a mailbox-grade check would refuse the one login such a host can use. Add a case here before changing either side.

cases.why: case and surrounding space are normalized away, not rejected
a plus tag is a real mailbox
the host does not demand a dot in the domain
a plain username is a login too — a host with no mail has no mailbox to demand
a short word is still a login
a name with a space in it is not a login
the none-mode local owner's own key must never be an email admin
an email that merely starts with the local scheme is still an email
